title: PlasmaQuick::Dialogs are inappropriately translucent if kwin blur effect is disabled
line: With the Blur effect off, Plasma popups, Application Menu submenus and tooltips are now opaque instead of showing the desktop through them.
explanation: Breeze has two versions of the dialog and tooltip backgrounds: one in translucent/ used when the Blur effect is available, and a regular one used without blur. Both were drawn at 85% opacity, so with blur the background is blurred and looks solid, but without blur the same popups showed icons and text from behind them unblurred, which is what reporters saw in Kicker submenus, tooltips and folder popups. The change makes the regular (no-blur) dialogs/background and widgets/tooltip fills opaque, like the solid/ variants; the blur variants are untouched.

commits.message:
desktoptheme/breeze: make dialogs and tooltips opaque without blur

The regular dialog and tooltip backgrounds were as translucent as the
ones used with blur, so without blur popups showed whatever was behind
them unblurred. Use opaque fills there, matching the solid variants.

BUG: 481595

media.caption: Blur off: the Development submenu (and the main menu) show the wallpaper and favorites icons through them
Blur off, with the fix: submenu and main menu are opaque
Blur off: the panel tooltip shows the desktop text behind it
Blur off, with the fix: the tooltip is opaque

review.text: Making Breeze's non-blurred dialogs/background.svg and widgets/tooltip.svg opaque fixes the exact cause of PlasmaQuick::Dialog popups, Kicker submenus, and tooltips showing unblurred desktop content behind them when the KWin Blur effect is disabled. Editing the regular composited variants preserves rounded corners and drop shadows while leaving the translucent/ blur variants untouched, and the before/after screenshots confirm both blur-off opacity and blur-on preservation.

reviews.text: Making Breeze's non-blurred dialogs/background.svg and widgets/tooltip.svg opaque fixes the exact cause of PlasmaQuick::Dialog popups, Kicker submenus, and tooltips showing unblurred desktop content behind them when the KWin Blur effect is disabled. Editing the regular composited variants preserves rounded corners and drop shadows while leaving the translucent/ blur variants untouched, and the before/after screenshots confirm both blur-off opacity and blur-on preservation.

ThemePrivate::updateKSvgSelectors only picks the translucent/ variants while the blur effect is active, so the base dialogs/background and widgets/tooltip SVGs are exactly the no-blur path. Those had the same 0.85 fill as the blur variants (0.9 before 2022), which is what made Kicker submenus, tooltips and folder popups see-through without blur. Dropping that opacity on the ColorScheme-Background fill elements fixes it at the theme level, as cwo described in c23/c25, and leaves the blurred look and the panel's own opacity setting alone. The before/after screenshots show the submenu, main menu and tooltip turning opaque with blur off, and the submenu stays translucent-blurred with blur back on; the commit message matches the SVG text diff.
